summary: The United States launched extensive strikes on over 80 targets across Iran overnight, hitting military bases in Khuzestan and Bushehr provinces and killing at least nine people, in retaliation for Iranian attacks on commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz. Iran's parliament speaker declared the "era of bullying over" and listed five U.S. violations of a prior understanding, while the Israeli military announced it expects days of engagement with Iran and full coordination with U.S. Central Command. President Trump threatened further strikes tonight and called Iranian leaders "sick" and "impotent," signaling a sharp escalation.
key_points: U.S. forces struck more than 80 targets in Iran overnight, including three military bases in Khuzestan province, leaving one dead and two injured. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/75069)
Two military bases in Bushehr province — one in Dashti County and another near Choghadak — were hit by enemy projectiles early Wednesday morning. (Source: @shin_persian/7520)
Explosions rocked Bandar Abbas, striking the Sayyad pier and nearby military centers, with at least eight fatalities reported. (Source: @kianmeli1/88509)
Iran's IRGC attacked three vessels near the Strait of Hormuz over the past two days, including a Saudi tanker today, prompting the U.S. response. (Source: @VahidOnline/76825, @pkpoi/143172)
Israeli army expects several days of engagement with Iran and possible full-scale war resumption, with full coordination with CENTCOM. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/75075)
Trump said the U.S. hit Iran "20 times harder than before" and threatened to strike again tonight, calling Iranian leaders "scum" and "impotent." (Source: @amitsegal/62866, @yediotnews25/132417)
Iran Parliament Speaker Ghalibaf accused the U.S. of five violations of a 14-point understanding, including attacks on southern Iran and renewed oil sanctions. (Source: @VahidOnline/76825)
CNN reports U.S. commanders bypassed warnings of outdated intelligence and struck a school, killing nearly 200 children and adults. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/4687)

sections.executive_summary: The United States launched extensive strikes on over 80 targets across Iran overnight, hitting military bases in Khuzestan and Bushehr provinces and killing at least nine people, in retaliation for Iranian attacks on commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz. Iran's parliament speaker declared the "era of bullying over" and listed five U.S. violations of a prior understanding, while the Israeli military announced it expects days of engagement with Iran and full coordination with U.S. Central Command. President Trump threatened further strikes tonight and called Iranian leaders "sick" and "impotent," signaling a sharp escalation.

points: U.S. strikes hit three military bases in Khuzestan province overnight, killing one person and wounding two, according to the province's deputy governor. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/75069)

Two military bases in Bushehr province — one in Dashti County and another near Choghadak — were struck by enemy projectiles early Wednesday, per the province's security deputy. (Source: @shin_persian/7520)

Explosions were reported in Bandar Abbas at 0624Z (09:54 local time), hitting the Sayyad pier and adjacent military centers, with local reports citing eight dead. (Source: @kianmeli1/88509, @shin_persian/7496)

Iran's Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf listed five U.S. violations of a 14-point understanding: violation of Iranian arrangements in the Strait of Hormuz, continuous threats of further attacks, strikes on southern Iran, reimposition of oil sanctions, and continued Israeli attacks on Lebanon. (Source: @VahidOnline/76825)
Admiral Sayyari, a senior Navy commander, warned that any hostile troop disembarkation on Iranian shores would meet an "inferno without exit." (Source: @presstv/197629)
PressTV reported that a multi-day funeral for "martyred Leader of Iran" Ayatollah Khamenei began Friday with his body lying in state at Tehran's Imam Khomeini Mosalla. (Source: @presstv/197639)
The U.S. is reportedly reviewing plans to eliminate several senior IRGC commanders, including Ahmad Vahidi, in a joint U.S.-Israel operation in coming days. (Source: @kianmeli1/88515)

The Israeli army announced it expects several days of engagement with the Iranian regime and the possibility of full-scale war resumption, citing full coordination with U.S. Central Command. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/75075)
Israeli attacks in southern Lebanon were cited by Ghalibaf as one of five U.S. violations of the understanding with Iran. (Source: @VahidOnline/76825, @yediotnews25/132419)
U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth canceled a planned visit to Israel today amid the escalation. (Source: @amitsegal/62870, @pkpoi/143182)
A joint U.S.-Israel operation to target senior IRGC commanders is reportedly under review for the coming days. (Source: @kianmeli1/88515)
Palestinians painted a mural in Gaza tribute to Ayatollah Khamenei with the text "Gaza will never forget you," per PressTV. (Source: @presstv/197633)
Ghalibaf accused the U.S. of violating the understanding by allowing continued Israeli attacks on southern Lebanon. (Source: @VahidOnline/76825, @yediotnews25/132419)
A helicopter was tracked heading toward northern occupied Palestine (southern Lebanon) per a monitoring channel. (Source: @redlinkleb/30566)
Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa landed in Ankara en route to the NATO summit, where he is expected to meet Trump. (Source: @asafroz/51159)
An investigative journalist discussed the purpose of U.S. presence in Iraq, stating the Resistance Front has frustrated Washington's long-term societal reshaping goals. (Source: @presstv/197632)
Saudi Foreign Ministry stated Iran attacked a Saudi tanker passing through the Strait of Hormuz earlier today. (Source: @pkpoi/143172)

Kuwait's Ministry of Electricity, Water and Renewable Energy reported several overhead power transmission lines damaged by shrapnel from air defense operations during recent Iranian attacks. (Source: @kianmeli1/88516)
A drone struck a tanker near the coast of Oman in the Strait of Hormuz, per UKMTO. (Source: @inon_yttach/9300)
The U.S. revoked Iran's sanctions waiver for oil production and sales following attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/4667)

key_developments: U.S. military struck over 80 targets in Iran overnight, including three bases in Khuzestan and two in Bushehr, in response to IRGC attacks on three ships near the Strait of Hormuz. (Source: @almogboker78/17666, @rodast_omiddana/75069, @shin_persian/7520)

At least nine people killed in U.S. strikes: one in Khuzestan, eight in Bandar Abbas; school strike reported by CNN killing nearly 200. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/75069, @kianmeli1/88509, @Faytuks_Network/4687)
Iran's Parliament Speaker Ghalibaf declared the "era of bullying over" and listed five U.S. violations of a 14-point understanding, vowing not to back down. (Source: @VahidOnline/76825)
Israeli army expects days of engagement with Iran and possible full-scale war, with full coordination with CENTCOM. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/75075)
Trump threatened to strike Iran again tonight, saying the U.S. hit them "20 times harder" and calling Iranian leaders "sick," "scum," and "impotent." (Source: @amitsegal/62866, @yediotnews25/132417)
Saudi tanker attacked in Strait of Hormuz; Kuwaiti power lines damaged by Iranian air defense shrapnel; drone hit tanker near Oman. (Source: @pkpoi/143172, @kianmeli1/88516, @inon_yttach/9300)
NATO Secretary General endorsed U.S. attack on Iran as "very decisive and necessary" for Israel and Europe. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/75078)
sections.threat_assessment: The conflict has entered a dangerous new phase with the U.S. conducting large-scale strikes on Iranian territory, explicitly targeting military infrastructure in multiple provinces. Iran's leadership has rejected de-escalation, framing the attacks as violations of a prior understanding and vowing resistance. The Israeli military's public expectation of days of engagement and full coordination with CENTCOM suggests a coordinated campaign may be underway. The reported strike on a school causing mass casualties, if confirmed, could galvanize domestic Iranian resolve and international scrutiny. Meanwhile, Iranian attacks on Gulf shipping and the threat to close the Strait of Hormuz risk global energy disruption. The cancellation of the U.S. Defense Secretary's Israel visit indicates fluid planning. The potential targeting of senior IRGC commanders in a joint operation signals a decapitation strategy. All actors are on a hair-trigger, with Trump's rhetoric ruling out near-term diplomacy.
sections.regional_response: Gulf states are directly affected: Saudi Arabia confirmed a tanker attack, Kuwait reported infrastructure damage from Iranian air defense activity, and Oman waters saw a drone strike. NATO's endorsement of the U.S. strikes aligns the alliance with Israeli and American objectives, potentially complicating European diplomacy. Syria's president attending the NATO summit in Ankara suggests Turkish mediation efforts may be in play. The PressTV-reported funeral for Khamenei, if accurate, would introduce profound leadership uncertainty in Iran, though this remains unverified by other sources. The region's air defense networks are actively engaged, as evidenced by Kuwaiti damage from interceptors. Economic impacts are immediate, with oil prices jumping and the Iranian currency plummeting past 180,000 tomans to the dollar.
sections.intelligence_notes: The CNN report that U.S. commanders bypassed warnings of severely outdated intelligence and struck a school raises serious questions about target validation processes and potential war crimes liability. The specific naming of Ahmad Vahidi as a target in a joint U.S.-Israel operation suggests actionable intelligence on IRGC leadership movements. The 14-point understanding referenced by Ghalibaf appears to have governed Strait of Hormuz interactions and sanctions relief; its collapse removes a key deconfliction mechanism. The coordination between Israeli and U.S. Central Command implies shared battle management, possibly including real-time intelligence sharing. The Iranian space program's announcement of Chabahar space base readiness amid war indicates dual-use technology advancement continues. The mural in Gaza honoring Khamenei reflects Iran's narrative influence among Palestinian factions. The Hungarian election coverage and Ukrainian drone strike on a Russian refinery are unrelated distractions in the data feed.
